costs.accounting_note: Each attempt ledger is read once, including registration and failures. Shared search and same-arm raw blocks are charged once physically; expanded logical cells are separate. Checks remain separately recorded; wrapper CPU overlaps its children and is not added. Historical references are retained without summing nested totals. Search loading and failed-invocation counts are not instrumented. Interrupted raw prefixes remain charged even without a closed ledger; unrecorded in-flight calls and CPU remain unknown. Summed wall time is not cohort elapsed time.
